visualCharacteristics.purpose: bordered collapsible FAQ / "Things you should know" panels

contentPattern.structure: one row per question: question label | answer (rich text, or a link to a /fragments/ path to load complex content). Single-cell rows are extra content (intro text, "View all FAQs" link); with the sidebar option the last single-cell row becomes the side column of related links

usage.when: FAQ questions and expandable terms/conditions panels

reuseGuidance: Use two-column for a 2-up question grid, sidebar for FAQs beside a links column, terms for the filled single "Things you should know" panel, lined for full-width ruled rows.
